apiId: Application identifier for Telegram API access, which can be obtained at https://my.telegram.org.
apiHash: Application identifier hash for Telegram API access, which can be obtained at https://my.telegram.org.
popularity: May be: all, new, good, best, discussion_all, discussion_flame, discussion_good
tag: optional, updates posts only from this tag
enableFilesDownloading: If false, bot will be sending files by url.
I don't recommend turning this off since sending by url have considerable limitations.
